Formula: Einstein Field Equations of General Relativity
Exact Expression: G_{\mu\nu} + \Lambda g_{\mu\nu} = \frac{8\pi G}{c^4} T_{\mu\nu}
Definitions: Ten coupled non-linear hyperbolic-elliptic partial differential equations describing gravitation as a manifestation of spacetime curvature caused by mass and energy.
Derivation/Reference: Albert Einstein, Die Feldgleichungen der Gravitation (Königlich Preußische Akademie der Wissenschaften, 1915); David Hilbert (1915)
Example: In vacuum (T_munu = 0, Lambda = 0), spherical symmetry yields unique Schwarzschild metric: ds^2 = -(1 - 2GM/(c^2 r)) c^2 dt^2 + (1 - 2GM/(c^2 r))^-1 dr^2 + r^2 dOmega^2
Domain: relativity
Assumptions: 4-dimensional pseudo-Riemannian spacetime manifold with Lorentzian signature (-+++); Torsion-free Levi-Civita connection
Common Errors: Treating gravity as a classical Newtonian force field instead of spacetime geometric curvature
subject: Einstein Field Equations of General Relativity
